main_text.head: PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p: simi Viri D. Joh. Macco-vii, Collegæ mei, Theologi celeberrimi; ut unicuique consensus noster palam fieret. Ego igitur, ut cum totâ Ecclesiâ Reformatâ, nec Magistratibus, nec Episcopis & Pastoribus quicquam detraho, quod eis secundùm verbum Dei competit, aut attribuo, quod non competit, sed Cæsari do, quæ sunt Cæsaris, & Deo, quæ Dei sunt; ita Deus sapientiæ, prudentiæ, pacis, concordiæ, mansuetudinis nobis-cum omnibus sit. Franecqueræ.

page.notes: The first word is cut off at the left edge of the scan, so only the fragment "simi" of "Clarissimi" is visible; it is kept as a fragment. The "Franecquerae" place name and the date line are set in a slightly different, italic-and-roman mix; the reading is from the visible letters. The printed text is in italic with roman capitals and the printed hyphens at line ends are kept. No printing errors were judged to be present. A faint "Digitized by Google" stamp at the bottom right was left out.
